guide_section: I want to add code to someone else's repository

workflow_1_guide_hosted.name: Hosted Fork & Pull Request
workflow_1_guide_hosted.precondition: Secondary hosted fork repository with write access
workflow_1_guide_hosted.ref_state: Creates refs/remotes/origin/topic and sets upstream tracking @{u}
workflow_1_guide_hosted.worktree_state: Clean working tree; no local patch files created
workflow_1_guide_hosted.commit_state: Commit ID preserved identically on remote fork

workflow_2_second_command.name: Patch Export & git am
workflow_2_second_command.precondition: Local repository only; no remote fork or network required
workflow_2_second_command.ref_state: No remote tracking ref created; local refs unchanged
workflow_2_second_command.worktree_state: Untracked patch file (0001-*.patch) in working tree
workflow_2_second_command.commit_state: Maintainer creates new commit ID with identical tree hash and author, but maintainer committer
